name: fmp_crypto_historical
description:
Daily end-of-day price history for one cryptocurrency pair from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/historical-price-eod/full as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (FMP crypto pair, e.g. BTCUSD).
For the latest quote use fmp_crypto_quote; for symbols fmp_crypto_list.
Example: {"symbol": "ETHUSD"}
